requirements.statement: Mission contracts shall validate required identity, objective, success criteria, change identifiers, dependency references, and risk values.
Mission dependency graphs shall reject self-dependencies, missing nodes, duplicate dependencies, and cycles deterministically.
The planner shall report a deterministic runnable frontier whose nodes have completed dependencies, without mutating mission or child ledgers.
Mission status shall project child KEEL ledger phases while preserving per-change governance as the source of truth.
